fixed.explanation: In online_ewma the decay exponent is indexed with the column index j (deltas[j - 1]) instead of the row index i. For a single column, j is 0, so deltas[-1] is always used. The decay therefore doesn't follow the time step and the result is wrong. Indexing with i - 1 fixes it.

query.intent: The expanding/online exponentially weighted mean implementation (EWMMean in pandas/core/window/online.py, used by ewm(...).online().mean()) computes the update with the decay/alpha weights. For single-column DataFrames the code path appears to skip the decay weighting and returns a cumulative mean; the weight update logic must apply the decay factor consistently with the non-online ewm mean.
query.symptom: Online ewm mean on a single-column DataFrame ignores the decay (alpha/com/span) and returns a plain cumulative mean, differing from the regular ewm mean.
